description: This file defines a class iCalendar_parameter that manages and validates parameters used in iCalendar components, including methods for checking allowed values, default values, validation, and formatting of parameters related to iCalendar standard.

classes.name: iCalendar_parameter
classes.description: A class responsible for handling iCalendar parameters, their default values, validation, and formatting according to RFC 2445 standards.

methods.name: multiple_values_allowed
methods.description: Checks if a given iCalendar parameter allows multiple values.

methods.name: default_value
methods.description: Returns the default value for a specific iCalendar parameter.

methods.name: is_valid_value
methods.description: Validates whether a given value for a parameter is valid based on its type and context.

methods.name: do_value_formatting
methods.description: Formats a parameter value according to iCalendar standards, such as quoting or case normalization.

methods.name: undo_value_formatting
methods.description: Placeholder for reverse formatting of parameter values (not implemented).
